title: PluginProfile
description: A profile a plugin declares (`contents.profiles`, ADR 0224): a named contract of tools that several plugin servers may implement (`implements: [<plugin>/<name>@<version>]` in plugin-server.schema.json) and that an agent may call by profile (`mcp_servers: [{profile: ...}]`) instead of by connector. The profile's identity is `<plugin>/<name>@<version>`; the core treats it as opaque and never reads what it means (ADR 0181). Every `input` and `output` is written in the SUBSET below, and a profile that uses anything outside it is refused at validation, so that the comparison of a server's schemas with the profile's never has to guess. THE SUBSET: `type` (one of object, array, string, integer, number, boolean, null, or a list of them), `properties`, `required`, `additionalProperties` (a boolean or a schema), `items` (one schema), `enum` and `const` (scalars only), `minimum`, `maximum`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `pattern`, `format` (date-time, date, time, uri, email, uuid), `$ref` (to `#/$defs/<name>` of the same profile, no cycle, no sibling but `description` and `title`), `description` and `title`; nothing else (no oneOf, anyOf, allOf, not, if, patternProperties, prefixItems, tuple items, `$ref` elsewhere). Comparison (`tranibor plugin validate`, ADR 0224 §2): a schema A is ACCEPTED BY a schema B when every instance valid under A is valid under B. A server's input schema must accept what the profile's input accepts (profile input accepted by the server's); the profile's output schema must accept what the server returns (server output accepted by the profile's). An absent `type` is any type; an absent `additionalProperties` is true; an absent `required` is empty; an absent bound is unbounded; a keyword of the server's schema outside the subset makes the comparison fail rather than pass.

schema.description: a schema in the profile subset: any other keyword is refused

name.description: unique within the profile; the operation name a server declares

access.description: required: nothing is assumed read; a server declares the same access

human_approval.description: a floor: a server may raise it, never lower it

platform_arguments.description: arguments the PLATFORM fills, never the agent (as in plugin-server.schema.json): a floor, a server may add some, never drop one

input.description: the tool's arguments, an object schema in the subset

output.description: the tool's structured answer, in the subset

name.description: unique within the plugin; the profile is named `<plugin>/<name>@<version>`

version.description: a breaking change is a new version, and both may be served

$defs.description: named schemas of the subset that `$ref` points to
